verdict.rationale: Kong offers an official Konnect MCP server (confirmed live via handshake probe) that would let AI agents/assistants issue natural-language commands against the Konnect platform, and Insomnia has AI-assisted features like natural-language mock server generation. However, this is auth-gated and separate from core Kong Gateway administration, which remains driven by Admin API, decK CLI, or Kong Manager rather than direct NL commands.
